title: Detecting the finer structure of the P vs NP problem with statistical mechanics: the case of the Wang tiling problem
summary: We introduce the idea that the P vs NP problem can have a finer structure. Given the NP complete problem of interest, the configurations space of the problem can be divided in (at least) two regions. In one region, polynomial algorithms to solve the NP complete problem of interest are available (and we discuss one possible realization inspire by the games of chess and go).
